title: core-shell, billing, reports pass team from package.json as owner

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty. core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner. Assumptions: team values hardcoded as literals matching each package.json 'team' because the in-house bundler can't import JSON; shared-contracts is an in-repo lib (inlined), so one PR in mono, no platform-kit change. All three apps built locally; CI and CD green.
